integrity: All finite obstruction cases and the generic seven-point case are enumerated without random sampling. The accompanying self-contained certificate implements exact interval traces and an independent cross-check.
scientific_limitations: Computer-assisted finite certificate after proved reductions; fixed-width boxes, online complexity and complete shattered-support counts are outside the theorem. The known continuous-torus dimension six is credited to earlier work. Complete historical priority and independent validation have not been established.
title: Exact VC dimensions of finite cyclic rectangles on two-dimensional tori
